name: Can crown molding be installed on textured drywall or popcorn ceilings?

mainEntity.name: Can crown molding be installed on textured drywall or popcorn ceilings?

acceptedAnswer.text: Rooms with popcorn or heavy knockdown textures require extra preparation before crown molding can sit flush. If molding is nailed directly against thick texture, noticeable gaps appear along the bottom and top edges. Contractors often scrape back or flatten the narrow strip of texture where the molding seats, or float out low spots with drywall compound. Because HH Remodeling manages drywall repair and finish carpentry together, textured ceilings can be prepped, skimmed, and cleanly tied into the new trim without hiring a separate drywall contractor.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, but heavy texture or popcorn must be scraped or floated smooth along the contact line first so the trim sits flush and caulked edges remain clean and straight.
